# TODO-324 steps 1-2 — distinct-source re-check

Generated by `tools/tapematch/recheck_distinct_source.py`. Scans `data/tapematch/runs/*/report.md` for `[DISTINCT SOURCE]` lines whose named source has `speed_kind == 'speed-unknown'` in `results.json` (the untrusted-ppm fallout from BUG-330), then classifies whether each run's written `analysis.md` verdict relies on that claim alone.

## Bucket counts

| Bucket | Count | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| only-claim | 603 | verdict's sole support is the bad claim — re-run candidate |
| unclear-no-mention | 365 | isolated in the verdict table, never discussed in prose — treated as re-run candidate (conservative) |
| other-evidence | 1547 | verdict also cites commentary/fingerprint/lineage evidence — no change needed |
| merged-despite-flag | 1 | written verdict already merged this source anyway — claim was not relied upon |
| unparseable | 10 | table/prose format didn't match — needs manual look |
| no-analysis | 1152 | run dir has no analysis.md — out of TODO-324 step-2 scope |

Total affected `[DISTINCT SOURCE]` lines scanned: **3678**

**665 dates** (699 run dirs) whose written verdict turns on an untrusted distinct-source claim (`only-claim` + `unclear-no-mention` buckets). Re-running tapematch for these dates is step 3, out of scope for this script.
